display_information.name: Intradiem GTM Brain
display_information.description: Lets Slackbot answer strike-plan, signal and impact questions from the GTM brain.
display_information.long_description: Connects Slackbot's MCP client to the hosted Intradiem GTM brain (read-only). Slackbot can list the ranked strike accounts, pull one account's strike plan, read expansion and risk signals, and read the impact scorecard. Every answer carries the snapshot's generated_at and freshness; stale or uncited figures are withheld by the brain, not shown. Authenticated by Slack request signature (slack_identity_auth): no API key is stored in Slack.
